name: Saiga Sniper
flavour: He saw you three ridges ago. The red lines mean he has stopped waiting.

doc: Garry's picture (pass 73): a saiga antelope in a long fringed poncho with a long scoped rifle. A special (gear badge), never an Elite, one at a time. He comes in at the map's edge (26 m off) and walks towards the hero like the Spit Cactus, a bit faster, until he is within 16 m; there he holds and aims, and he never runs away (pass 81). Aiming, he stands frozen in his aiming pose: thin red lines sweep in from the sides of his aim and gather on the hero, more and faster, following him for 2 s; then they lock, hold 1 s, and a laser crosses the whole map along the locked line, leaving red sparks. It hits the hero for 0.7 x the Vulture Raider's rocket at the same stage and shoves him, and it nicks the creatures on its line (5% of their health) and pushes them aside. A shot every 9 s or so. A hit spoils his aim (no shot).

SS-0.note: the top-level strip, before the Level Editor's looks
